Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Wesley Madhevere and Innocent Kaia are set to open the innings for Zimbabwe. Fazalhaq Farooqi will start off proceedings with the new ball for Afghanistan.
... The Run Chase ...

Zimbabwe began on the right foot. Their seamers bowled well and helped Zimbabwe get early inroads. However, they failed to capitalize on that and the momentum shifted towards Afghanistan. The spinners did bowl well in the middle phase and put a lid on the run flow. But they leaked over 60 runs in the last 5 overs and let the game slip. They would be happier if they would have restricted Afghanistan to anywhere near 150. A couple of misfields dropped catches, and also giving 13 runs away in extras might have cost them those few more runs. Nevertheless, 170 is a gettable score and Zimbabwe are capable of getting over the line. Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

After electing to bat first, Afghanistan put up a score of 51 but lost 3 wickets. Hazratullah Zazai gave them the perfect start but he perished soon after that. They did lose wickets at regular intervals in the start but they made sure the run rate was always over 7. The runs though had dried up in the middle phase. But Mohammad Nabi and Najibullah Zadran put together 70 runs and helped Afghanistan get to the 170-mark. Najibullah Zadran brought his half-ton, while Mohammad Nabi scored a fine 43.

End of an entertaining first half of this game!  63 runs in the last 5 overs has helped Afghanistan have put a total of 170 The average score on this ground is around 165 and the visitors have managed to put a score just above average. It's been a good batting effort nevertheless. Zimbabwe will be a tad bit disappointed but they are well in contention to win this game. It's not a mammoth target.

Excellent running and it is a really strong finish from Afghanistan. Full and outside off, Nabi thumps it on the bounce towards the man at deep point and looks for two straightaway. Nabi races back and makes it comfortably. Afghanistan finish with 170/5!
SIX! One poor delivery and the over is spoiled! A juicy full toss on leg stump, Mohammad Nabi just swings it away, over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Excellent final over so far from Tendai Chatara. Gets it very full and at the stumps, Rashid can only manage to work it leg side for one.
Full toss, on off. Nabi mistimes it towards long on and the fielder over there does well to attack the ball. Just the single again.
Full and wide, drilled down to long off for a run.
Full and straight, big swing from Nabi but he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Rashid Khan comes to the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is full and spilled down the leg side, wide called. But wait, the skipper wants the strike and is off his mark. Najibullah Zadran turns and sees this and has to go for it. Regis Chakabva throws the ball to the bowler and Tendai Chatara whips off the bails at the bowler's end. The decision is taken upstairs and the replay shows that Zadran is short of his crease. An unfortunate end to his innings but well played nonetheless.

TWO BYES! Very full and very slow on the off pole. Mohammad Nabi swings through the line but misses the ball yet again. There's a slight fumble from the keeper and this allows the batters to pick up two byes.
Missed opportunity! Fuller and around off, it is in the slot but Nabi goes a bit too hard at it and misses the ball completely.
WIDE! And again! Pacy delivery, way outside the off stump. Wided.
WIDE! Way too many extras and these runs will hurt Zimbabwe at the moment. Full and wide, delivered beyond the tramline outside off.
A low full toss, around off. Nabi gets an inside edge towards the square leg region and picks up a couple of runs.
SIX! BOOM! Pitched up, right in the slot around middle. Mohammad Nabi hangs deep and clobbers it over the long on fence for a biggie.

DROPPED! Yet another valiant effort from Tadiwanashe Marumani but he should have held onto this one. Back of a length, on off. Zadran swings through the line and mistimes it badly towards the mid-wicket region. Marumani runs in and gets to the ball but ends up spilling it. The throw is a bit wide as well and the batters get three runs in the end.
Full and wide, Najibullah Zadran swings hard at it but misses.

SIX! Brilliant effort in the deep by Tadiwanashe Marumani but it will be a maximum. Banged in short, over middle and leg. Nabi lays into it but doesn't time it quite well. Marumani runs to his left from the mid-wicket fence and puts in the dive but can't hold on to the catch as the ball goes over the ropes.
Gets it full and wide again, Zadran can only drive it through covers for one.

Short run! Just a bit too eager there Najibullah Zadran and after all the effort, it will only be a single. Full and wide, Zadran gets it off the inner half of the bat towards the mid-wicket region. The batters race back for two but they will only get a single.
Gets in the yorker around leg stump, Nabi jams it out towards long off and collects a single.
FOUR! Attempted slower bumper from Donald Tiripano but it's just a bit too straight. Mohammad Nabi waits for it and helps it around the corner for a boundary.
Gets it full and wide this time, Zadran slices it towards short third man for a single.
WIDE! Looking for the wide yorker but misses his mark and a wide is called.

Leg bye! Fuller and on the pads, Zadran looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg as the batters scamper through for one. The bowler seems interested but the umpire remains unmoved.
Nice comeback from Chatara. This is on a length, slower and pushed wider. Zadran backs away looking to go downtown but fails to reach it.

FOUR! Overpitched and punished! In the slot, on off and Najibullah Zadran just muscles it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary. Fifty up for Zadran as well, continuing his good form from the last game.
Full and on leg stump, heaved towards wide long on for just a single.
Hit hard but just for one. Around off, thumped straight towards the man at extra cover for a quick single.
Full and straight, driven to the left of the bowler who makes a good diving stop to his left.
Tendai Chatara (2-0-14-2) comes back to bowl.

SIX! Easy as! Sikandar Raza drags it down again around leg stump and gets perished. Mohammad Nabi rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 13 off the over, a good one for Afghanistan.
Quicker one, sliding down leg, Zadran flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
The call is for two but it will only be a single. On a length, around middle. Nabi pushes it gently in front of square on the leg side but the fielder is quick to get to it. Just the single.
A huge swing and a miss! This is flighted past the leg stump, Mohammad Nabi backs away and throws the kitchen sink at it but doesn't connect.
Raza pushes this one quicker and on off, Zadran strokes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! This is dragged down well outside off, Najibullah Zadran hangs back and hammers it over extra cover for a boundary.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Excellent stop! Fuller ball, outside off. Najibullah Zadran drives it firmly towards extra-cover. Craig Ervine dives to his left and makes a terrific stop. Single taken!
Outside off, quicker now, shorter. Najibullah Zadran tries to cut this away but he misses.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Fuller ball, around middle. Najibullah Zadran reverse-sweeps this aerially over short third man for a boundary.
Slower through the air, full in length, around off. Mohammad Nabi miscues his drive down to long on. Single taken!
Full in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran drives it through cover for a single.
Tosses it up, very full, around off. Mohammad Nabi knocks it down to long off for a single. 100 up for Afghanistan!
Swing and a miss! A shorter ball, slower in pace, outside off. Najibullah Zadran looks to pull this but he misses.
Wide! Length delivery, wide of off. Najibullah Zadran leaves it alone. Wide called!
Darting it on the pads, on a length. Najibullah Zadran flicks it towards short fine leg. A slight misfield there allows the batter to take two runs.
Angling in on a length, around middle and leg. Mohammad Nabi works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Mohammad Nabi guides it down to third man for a brace.
Tad shorter, width on offer. Najibullah Zadran pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
On a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Luke Jongwe errs in line and spills it down leg. Najibullah Zadran looks to flick but he misses. Wide called!
Zimbabwe sensing an opportunity here as Luke Jongwe is brought back into the attack.
Once again wide of off, full in length. Mohammad Nabi drives it firmly but finds the fielder at extra-cover.
Wide of off, fuller ball. Mohammad Nabi presses forward and leaves it alone.
Wide! Down the leg side. Left alone. Wide called!
Shorter, googly this time, outside off. Najibullah Zadran cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length. Mohammad Nabi leans and drives it aerially through cover for a single.
The skipper, Mohammad Nabi walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Zimbabwe has struck just when Afghanistan were about to build a partnership! Ryan Burl strikes this time he sends back Karim Janat! Wicket at a good time for Zimbabwe. A lovely delivery! Tosses it up, full. This one lands around off and spins away. Karim Janat gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he manages to get a slight outside edge. Regis Chakabva the keeper takes yet another good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Full, around middle. Najibullah Zadran drives it down to long on for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Najibullah Zadran knocks it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! There is no stopping that one! Shorter and width on offer this time. Najibullah Zadran slashs it past cover for a boundary.
Full again, around off. Karim Janat makes room and plays this inside out over cover for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Karim Janat slogs it over mid-wicket for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle. Najibullah Zadran pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, quicker, around off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and tries to cut this away but he gets an under-edge back onto the deck.
Time for some more spin as Wesley Madhevere has been handed the ball.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Touch fuller, on the pads. Karim Janat flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Beauty! A leg-break, full, and outside off. Karim Janat leans and looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower through the air, full again, on the pads. Karim Janat leans and tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran taps it towards square leg and takes a single.
Ryan Burl begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Najibullah Zadran fails to reach out to the ball there.
Ryan Burl comes into the attack.
This is speared into middle stump, Zadran drives it down to long off and picks up a single. At the halfway mark, Afghanistan are 75/3!
On the pads, tucked away past mid-wicket for a run.
Good fielding! Shorter and a bit of width on offer as well, Janat slaps it past point but Luke Jongwe moves swiftly to left from the cover-point fence and keeps it down to a couple of runs.
Sliding into leg stump, Zadran backs away and pushes it towards covers for a single.
On middle, this is driven straight back past the bowler for only a single.
Quicker delivery from Raza, close to the off pole and on a shorter length. Karim Janat looks to cut but misses as the keeper fumbles as well.
Single to end the over. On middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Janat guides it towards the man at short fine leg.
On off, nicely driven through mid off for a run.

SIX! Clean strike! Just tossed up in the slot, around middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran clears the front leg and powers it well over the long on fence for a biggie. Zadran is the key here for Afghanistan.
A bit fuller and on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Pushed through quicker and around off, Janat plays it towards cover.
On middle, pushed through wide mid on for just another single. Zimbabwe just looking to tighten the screws here and not allow any freebies.
Around off, Janat drives it back towards the bowler.
Length again, on middle, turned through square leg for one more.
Floated up on a shorter length and turning into middle, Janat waits for it and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, on a length and around middle. Karim Janat just blocks it out.
Raza drags it down first up and pushes it wide off the off stump, Zadran reaches out and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack.
On the pads, swept away hard and low towards deep backward square leg for one.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! At the stumps, Najibullah Zadran gets in position quickly to reverse sweep and does so aerially over backward square leg for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, angling into middle. Zadran keeps it out on the leg side.
A bit of an appeal from the bowler but the umpire isn't interested. This is angled onto the pads, Zadran looks to work it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Around off, pushed towards mid off.
This is floated up, full and around off. Zadran defends it out.
Darwish Rasooli is walking off the field! He is seen holding his ribs while walking out. Karim Janat walks out to bat.

Oh, no! Darwish Rasooli is down again and seems to be in terrible pain out there. This is banged in short and outside off, Rasooli slaps it off the back foot but can't get it through cover. At the end of the Powerplay, Afghanistan are 51/3!
Slight halt! Darwish Rasooli seems to have pulled a muscle while running. The physio is out there to have a check on him. He seems fine and we are good to resume.

Risky single but Zadran was in! Fuller and outside off, a mistimed drive towards extra cover and they set off for the single. The fielder fails to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. Darwish Rasooli however is holding his back on the other side and might have just pulled a muscle, hope he is fine.

FOUR! Top delivery but it goes to the fence! Length again, around off and this one just nips in ever so slightly. Zadran looks to drive from inside the crease but gets an inside edge that runs past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
This is on a length and angled a fair bit across the left-hander. Najibullah Zadran goes chasing after it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Goes fuller and bowls it on middle, Zadran drives it straight towards mid on.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a way to start off the spell by Luke Jongwe and Afghanistan are now three down inside the Powerplay! Jongwe starts off with a gentle loosener down the leg side, Usman Ghani looks to tickle it fine but just gets a faint edge on it. Regis Chakabva moves swiftly to his left to take a simple catch. Afghanistan losing the plot a bit here by giving away cheap wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Luke Jongwe comes into the attack to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Pitches it up, outside off. Darwish Rasooli drives it uppishly over extra-cover for another boundary in the over.
Wide! Another going down the leg side. Darwish Rasooli tries to glance this but he misses. Wide called!
On a length, around middle. Darwish Rasooli blocks it out.
FOUR! Up and over! Tad fuller now, around off. Darwish Rasooli lifts it over extra-cover for a boundary.

Quick single! Direct-hit would have been curtains for Darwish Rasooli! Tad shorter, around off. Usman Ghani taps it off the back foot towards cover and runs across to the other end. Craig Ervine runs forward, collects the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end but he misses. Single taken!
Wide! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Usman Ghani looks to flick this but he misses. Wide given!
Donald Tiripano drops it short again, width on offer. Darwish Rasooli stays in his crease and tries to punch this on the offside, but the ball goes off the outside edge past point for a single.
Well bowled! Back of a length, outside off. Darwish Rasooli hangs back and tries to push this on the off side but he gets beaten.

Good fielding there! Shortish ball, around middle. Darwish Rasooli drags it with the inner half of his bat through mid on. The fielder there chases the ball, dives, and keeps the ball away from the ropes. Saved a single a certain run there. Three taken!
Another length delivery, around off. Darwish Rasooli dabs it with soft hands towards point.
On a length, around off. Darwish Rasooli blocks it out.
Darwish Rasooli is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Tendai Chatara has the last laugh! Good comeback from Chatara, he gets rid of the dangerous Hazratullah Zazai, and Afghanistan have lost their second wicket. Another short ball, tighter line this time, around off. Cramping Hazratullah Zazai for room. Hazratullah Zazai tries to cut this square of the wicket on the offside but the ball goes off the inside back onto the stumps.
SIX! Bang! This time it's from the middle of the bat! Another short ball, around middle and off. Hazratullah Zazai pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 10 runs off two balls!
FOUR! JUST OVER! Tendai Chatara drops it short, around middle. Hazratullah Zazai miscues his pull shot just over the diving fielder at short fine leg. Boundary!
Full in length, outside off. Usman Ghani presses forward and drives it powerfully but finds the fielder at cover.
Quick single! On a length, around off. Hazratullah Zazai taps it towards cover and scampers across to the other end.
FOUR! Top shot! Pitches it up again, outside off. Hazratullah Zazai lunges forward and drives it uppishly over cover for a boundary.
Angling in, full in length, around middle and leg. Usman Ghani flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller now, around middle and off. Usman Ghani pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, around off. Hazratullah Zazai looks to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. Single taken!
A change in the bowling right away as Donald Tiripano comes into the attack.
On a length, around middle and off. Usman Ghani defends it out. End of a successful over from Tendai Chatara!
Usman Ghani walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! An early breakthrough for Zimbabwe! This is just what they needed. Tendai Chatara strikes and he draws first blood. A stunning catch from Regis Chakabva though. A shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays in his crease and tries to cut this away, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards the keeper. Regis Chakabva springs to his right and takes a terrific catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! On a length this time, darting it on the pads. Hazratullah Zazai looks to flick but he misses. The ball goes off his thigh pads towards short fine leg and the batters take a leg bye!
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz dabs it towards point and takes a single. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is off the mark!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Tendai Chatara begins with a shorter ball, outside off, shaping away. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to cut this away but he misses.
Tendai Chatara to operate with the new ball from the opposite end.
Another sweep from Hazratullah Zazai! Sweeps this fuller ball towards short fine leg. 12 runs off the first over!
Ainsley Ndlovu maintains the same length, down leg again. Hazratullah Zazai sweeps again and finds the fielder at short fine leg.
FOUR! Down leg, full in length. Hazratullah Zazai gets down on his knee and sweeps it fine behind the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Hazratullah Zazai on the charge starightaway! A fuller ball, around middle. Hazratullah Zazai dispatches this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slower through the air, full, down the  leg side. Hazratullah Zazai once again sweeps but finds the fielder at short fine leg.

IN THE AIR...AND SAFE! A loopy ball, to begin with, full, around middle. Hazratullah Zazai gets down to sweep but the ball goes off the top edge towards third man. Two taken! Afghanistan and Hazratullah Zazai are underway!

We are all set for action to begin! The players are out in the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai will open the batting for Afghanistan. Ainsley Ndlovu will begin with the ball. Let's go!

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is down near the pitch. He says that the conditions are similar to the previous game. Adds that today they will be playing on pitch number 4 and it was used in the second ODI, it is well rolled, dry, and hard and it is good for batting. Mentions that there is a little bit of grass on this wicket not much and also spinners are not going to play a major role. Informs that the average score is around 160 here, but a total of 180 is possible. Further adds that the captain winning the toss should put runs on the board.

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe says that they are fine with chasing and this is the same pitch as the second ODI, so, should be good. Mentions that they do need an improved performance today and also informs that unfortunately, Blessing Muzarabani is out and also Milton Shumba makes way for Tadiwanashe Marumani.

Afghanistan skipper, Mohammad Nabi says they will bat first, it was tough in the middle in the previous game but eventually, they did well. On being asked about Nijat Masood, he says that on his debut, he bowled brilliantly and hopefully he continues bowling the same way. Informs that they are playing with the same team.

Afghanistan (Unchanged XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Usman Ghani, Darwish Rasooli, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Azmatullah Omarzai, Rashid Khan, Karim Janat, Fazalhaq Farooqi and Nijat Masood.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Wesley Madhevere, Innocent Kaia, Craig Ervine (C), Sikandar Raza, Tadiwanashe Marumani (In for Milton Shumba), Regis Chakabva (WK), Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Ainsley Ndlovu, Tendai Chatara, Donald Tiripano (In for Blessing Muzarabani).
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!
